text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running alongside K.S.Miracle and getting 
totally hyped by her insane speed. 
Apparently, she's planning to run in the 
Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of everyone who watched over 
her frail self, K.S.Miracle is fired up to 
win a GⅠ and repay their support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ruby-chan's running too, so Helios totally 
has to cheer! Push past your limits and 
make a miracle happen! Daitaku Helios 
pumps up the hype.
